content.thinking: I've drafted the full dungeon scene module in one pass—stone floor, treasure chest, barrel, crates, candle/skull pile, torch, potion shelf, cracked pot, weapon rack, and cobweb/coins/key, all in hard-texel pixel art using tileBox and cellPaint with a limited palette. It's unchecked against the SDK's typecheck and render yet, so I'll need to verify it next.
